question: What placement and defining mark complete the prescribed arrangement of the ritual vessels?
premises: The madhuparka offering is prescribed to be placed in the middle.
This placement follows the previously stated positions of other vessels.
The stated positions together constitute the characteristic arrangement of the vessels.
inference: Therefore, the central placement of the madhuparka completes the defining arrangement of the ritual vessels.
plain_english: But in the middle should be the madhuparka; thus this is the characteristic arrangement of the vessels.
